reuse.why: Reuses RSchedule, recurConfigToRSchedule and getDateWithSkippedWeekend, but re-derives the daily-skip vs non-daily-move weekend rule that shared/schedules.ts getNextDate already owns.

duplication.why: The skipWeekend/daily branching duplicates the weekend decision inside getNextDate (and the ±2-day window plus per-occurrence adjust echoes getUpcomingDates).

placement.why: The handler sits next to getUpcomingDates in server/schedules/app.ts as the tree does, though the weekend rule itself belongs in shared/schedules.ts.

scope.why: Adds only the handler, its registration/type and focused tests; the extra monthUtils namespace import is the only noise.

maintainability.why: A future change to the weekend rule must be made in getNextDate and in this new function, and the two already express it differently ('daily' vs 'DAILY', separate data fields).

bypasses_abstraction.where: getDatesInRange in server/schedules/app.ts applies the weekend rule itself instead of going through the shared schedule date logic in shared/schedules.ts (getNextDate's skipDailyWeekend/adjust).

disguised_duplication.where: getDatesInRange restates getNextDate's daily-weekend skip and non-daily getDateWithSkippedWeekend move as a reshaped loop condition over config fields.
